About the studio

Designing spaces that define you.

A residential interior design studio in Islamabad — blending smart planning with warm materials to create homes that feel effortless and endure.

Who we are

Creativity, met with practicality.

At Home Studio Interiors we blend smart planning with warm materials to create homes built for daily life. With over eight years shaping interiors across Islamabad and Rawalpindi, we pair local craftsmanship with modern detail and accountable project management.

From modular kitchens and custom wardrobes to vanities, doors and media walls, one team carries your project from first sketch to final handover — with 3D visualisation, an itemised BOQ and a one-year workmanship warranty.

How we work

A calm, transparent process.

01

Consultation & Site Visit

We map your lifestyle, rooms and budget, then measure the space to begin a personalised plan for your home.

02

Design & Planning

Layouts, mood boards and 3D interior visuals with material options — delivered with an itemised BOQ and schedule for sign-off.

03

Execution

Our site team builds to approved drawings — civil, carpentry, finishes and lighting — with weekly updates and rigorous quality checks.

04

Review & Handover

We snag, style and hand over your space, followed by warranty and aftercare so everything works beautifully.
